::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## 🚧 Coming soon
Each note will explain one influential paper in plain language: the problem, the key idea, one interactive figure, and what it changed. Here is what is planned first.
:::

| | Paper | Year | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|---|
| 🧠 | Attention Is All You Need | 2017 | Introduced the transformer behind modern language models |
| 👁️ | Deep Residual Learning (ResNet) | 2015 | Skip connections made very deep networks trainable |
| 🎯 | You Only Look Once (YOLO) | 2016 | Real-time object detection in a single pass |
| 🌲 | XGBoost | 2016 | The workhorse of tabular machine learning |
| 🧾 | Hidden Technical Debt in ML Systems | 2015 | Why production ML is mostly not about the model |
| 🔎 | Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) | 2020 | Grounding language models in your own documents |

While you wait, the [Resources hub](/resources/resources-overview.qmd) lists where to follow new research, including [Hugging Face Trending Papers](https://huggingface.co/papers/trending).
